description: Precision-focused benchmark: hard negatives that tempt a detector into false positives, plus clear positives to catch over-filtering. Used to measure the verification pass.
changelog: 1.0.0 — 16 cases: 12 clean hard negatives (valid causation, expertise, reported fallacies, hedging, emotional evidence, genuine constraints) and 4 clear fallacies.
